decisions: Map root semantics: release map-registry DEV_ASSETS resolution wins; imported experiment modules consume DEV_ASSETS from the compiler and therefore follow it. `.corpus`/atlas remain repository-relative external products with --corpus-root/--atlas-root overrides.
Ego controller: the experimental default (sensor-limited, line-of-sight gated) becomes the only policy; the omniscient-legacy compatibility profile is removed and the trace header field is required.
Condition comparators lt/lte/gt/gte (engine input schema, triggers, compiler CMP map, OpenSCENARIO mapRule) are adopted; NativeFoundation models simforge-core Comparison on the 4-value set.

scene_absolute initialRoute becomes a discriminated union lanePath|customRoute|customTimedRoute; compiler lowers customRoute -> polyline and customTimedRoute -> timedPolyline; portable lifting rejects exact scene-space routes (initial_route_not_portable); packages/editor consumers updated (SharedStudioHost consented).

asset-catalog gallery module (gallery.ts + gallery.generated.ts, clipAssets schema, child pedestrian motion/physics params in catalog.json/catalog.ts) was included because experiments/agentic-3d/asset-library.mjs reads gallery.generated.ts, geometry-binding.mjs mints gallery.generated.<sha256> ids, situation-sensing-policy.mjs pins packages/asset-catalog/catalog.json, and the compiler actor-catalog-agreement test asserts the child stature/footprint propagation; gallery GLBs stay external by contentHash.
